project_type: Next.js 14 full-stack web application (Bhutan Travel Experience Library)
test_framework: Jest with React Testing Library for component tests
verification_instructions: 1. Run npm install to install dependencies. 2. Run npm run build to verify the project compiles. 3. Run npm test to verify tests pass. 4. Run npm run dev to start dev server and manually verify pages load.
setup_instructions: 1. cd /projects/sandbox/Brainstrom 2. npm install 3. npm run dev
environment_constraints: Node.js v22.22.3 and npm 11.4.2 available. Docker available. No known network restrictions.
contribution_requirements: Greenfield project - no existing contribution guidelines.
key_patterns: Next.js App Router pattern with TypeScript. Data stored in structured JSON/TS data files. Tailwind CSS for styling. Component-based architecture with reusable UI components.
directory_structure: src/app/ - Next.js App Router pages, src/data/ - structured data with prices, src/lib/ - business logic (calculator, customizer), src/components/ - reusable React components, public/ - static assets
